note: Recorded sample output for demos and tests, written for the medication-reminders sample brief.

output.summary: A calm, consistent design that follows both platforms well. Three things need fixing before release: marking a dose can't be undone, offline answers look already saved, and the reminder sheet's focus behaviour isn't specified.
strengths: One clear primary action on every screen, sized for older users
Status is never shown by colour alone
Errors are calm, specific and always offer a way forward
The reminder sheet keeps the most common answer within thumb reach

findings.title: Loading state isn't announced to screen readers
findings.evidence: Skeleton or spinner without an accessible status text
findings.detail: Screen reader users aren't told that content is loading.
findings.recommendation: Reference the screen's loading a11y string on the skeleton or spinner.

findings.title: 'Mark as taken' can't be undone
findings.evidence: Marking a dose moves straight on with no confirmation and no undo.
findings.detail: A mistaken tap records a dose as taken when it wasn't; the person may skip it, and a carer won't be alerted.
findings.recommendation: After marking, show a confirmation with an Undo action for a few seconds, and let people change a dose's answer from Today.

findings.title: Offline answers look already saved
findings.evidence: Rows marked while offline show 'Taken 8:04 AM' exactly like synced rows.
findings.detail: The carer's view won't update until the phone reconnects, so they may get a not-marked alert for a dose that was taken.
findings.recommendation: Show 'Waiting to sync' on rows answered while offline, and clear it once synced.

findings.title: No words for undo and waiting-to-sync
findings.evidence: The content deck has no strings for these states.
findings.detail: The fixes for C1 and C2 need copy that matches the voice.
findings.recommendation: Add a confirmation, an Undo label and a 'Waiting to sync' status.

findings.title: Reminder sheet focus behaviour isn't specified
findings.evidence: No note on where focus goes when the sheet opens or whether the screen behind is inert.
findings.detail: Screen reader and keyboard users may land behind the sheet and not find the answers.
findings.recommendation: Move focus to the sheet title on open, make the screen behind inert, and return focus to the dose on close.

findings.title: One generic message for two different form errors
findings.heuristic: H9 Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
findings.evidence: The banner says 'Enter a name and at least one time' even when only the time is missing.
findings.detail: People have to work out which field is wrong.
findings.recommendation: Show only the message for the field that is missing; keep the banner as a summary when both are.

findings.title: 'Log a past dose' is the primary action on History
findings.evidence: A filled primary button on a read-mostly screen, for a feature the architecture lists as an open question.
findings.detail: It draws attention away from reading the history, and the feature may not ship.
findings.recommendation: Make it secondary, or remove it until the open question is decided.

findings.title: Settings tab shown although Settings isn't designed
findings.evidence: Settings is P2 with only a default state.
findings.detail: An empty or placeholder Settings screen would feel unfinished.
findings.recommendation: Keep the tab only if Settings ships in the first release.

heuristicsReviewed.note: Offline answers look the same as synced ones (C2).

heuristicsReviewed.heuristic: H2 Match between system and the real world
heuristicsReviewed.note: Plain words; 'Not marked' avoids blaming people.
No way to undo 'Mark as taken' (C1).
Platform conventions followed on iOS and Android.
A mistaken tap records a dose that wasn't taken (C1).
Today shows each dose's status; nothing to remember.

heuristicsReviewed.heuristic: H7 Flexibility and efficiency of use
heuristicsReviewed.note: Answering from the notification is one tap.
One primary action per screen; calm layouts.

heuristicsReviewed.heuristic: H9 Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors

heuristicsReviewed.note: No help content is in scope for the first release.

wcagChecked.note: Lists, headings and labels are structured.
Status uses icons and words as well as colour.
All text pairs meet 4.5:1 in both modes (design-system check).
Focus ring and control borders meet 3:1.
The reminder sheet doesn't say where focus goes or that the screen behind is inert (C4).
Focus states are defined for every interactive component.
Field errors are named in text next to the field.
